newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT POUND OVERNIGHT RATES FALL IN LIQUID MKT.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT POUND OVERNIGHT RATES FALL IN LIQUID MKT.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Egyptian pound fell in a liquid private sector market on Thursday to between 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent from between eight and 9-3/8 percent on Wednesday, bankers said.
"The market is liquid. It's normal at this time of the week," one banker said.
The market is traditionally liquid on Thursday, the last day of the business week.
Average one-week rates also slipped to between 7-7/8 and nine percent compared to Wednesday's 8-1/2 and nine percent, bankers added. $1 = 3.395 pounds
